name: Gagarin International Airport — historical civilian construction

references.purpose: Official documentation of a newly built civilian airport entering service in August 2019; not a pixel-level change label.
Dated April 2019 construction progress; not a claim that the 2016 site was unchanged.

selectionPolicy: Same Sentinel-1A IW GRD, pass direction, relative orbit, VV and processing options, covering site plus controls. Confirm actual construction stage in independent dated optical imagery. Summer windows reduce but do not remove seasonal effects.
heldOutPolicy: Select additional acquisitions and independently documented unchanged areas before threshold tuning. Record held-out acquisition IDs in a separate protocol; never relabel development results as held-out.
evaluationStatus: pending real scientific rasters and independent labels
limitations: Search bounds are a coarse discovery envelope, not a surveyed airport boundary.
No current flight, aircraft or operational-status inference is part of this construction evaluation.
Do not treat catalogue metadata or generated fixtures as real-data detection validation.
candidateStatus: Candidate geometry/season match only; covering controls, optical labels and scientific processing remain pending.
